slides.stem: In the $xy$-plane, the line $y = 6x + b$ is tangent to the parabola $y = 3x^2 - 12$, where $b$ is a constant. What is the value of $b$?

slides.intro: Tangent means the system has exactly one solution.
slides.trapWhy: $15$ drops a sign in the last line. Slow down exactly there.

slides.title: Tangency is a discriminant question
slides.body:
A line tangent to a parabola touches once, so setting them equal must give exactly one solution: $b^2 - 4ac = 0$.

This is the standard hard-Module-2 disguise for the discriminant. The word "tangent" is the tell.
